dog.description_text: May is currently in foster care and ready for adoption via our virtual process! May, a four-year-old female, just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CR-WN-FsksD6W65Kgr2N8nrQ220DlZwJ/view?usp=drive_link May is sweet and likes to play. Her foster says "May is super sweet and quiet. It takes a bit of time for her to warm up to you, so it is very rewarding when she makes small progress in becoming more social!". May is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
